## Bio

I am a PhD candidate in theoretical physics at the **Instituto de Estructura de la Materia (IEM-CSIC)** in Madrid. My research lies at the interface of loop quantum gravity, quantum cosmology, and early-Universe phenomenology.

A central part of my work concerns **primordial black holes and black-hole remnants**, including their possible role as dark matter and the cosmological signatures of quantum-gravity effects. I also work on numerical tools for **Lorentzian spinfoam amplitudes** and their applications to spinfoam cosmology.

## Research Networks

* **[WithOut SpaceTime (WOST)](https://withoutspacetime.org/):** International network exploring physics beyond classical space and time; my PhD research is based in the Madrid hub.
* **[COST Action CA23130 (BridgeQG)](https://web.infn.it/BridgeQG/):** Member of WG1 (*High-energy quantum gravity theory*) and WG2 (*High-energy quantum gravity experiment*).
* **[COST Action CA23115 (RQI)](https://rqi-cost.org/):** Member of WG2 (*Gravitational quantum physics and metrology*) and WG3 (*Time, causality, and memory in quantum physics*).
